financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Firm commitment underwritten public offering of units (gross proceeds; net not stated)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On February 15, 2024, the Company closed a firm commitment underwritten public offering with gross proceeds to the Company of approximately $10.0 million.

warrants.quote: As of March 28, 2024, we had a total of 963,693 tradeable warrants outstanding.
The initial exercise price of each Series A Warrant is $2.10 per share of common stock or pursuant to an alternative cashless exercise option.
The initial exercise price of each Series B Warrant is $2.38 per share of common stock.
The Pre-Funded Warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.001 per share and may be exercised at any time until exercised in full.
